meta.description: Every SaaS rebuilds the same auth, billing, teams, and multi-tenancy before writing a single line of product code. Fonderie is the open standard for that infrastructure — a skill wired into your repo, running on your server, against your database. Compose it in an afternoon; spend the rest on the part that's actually yours.
